versions.changelog:
- Initial release of HACCP Food Safety Guard.
- Audits food safety plans, HACCP records, and inspection reports for compliance with Codex HACCP principles and ISO 22000.
- Flags nonconforming hazard analyses, CCP limits, and verification records with clear fix suggestions.
- Provides structured compliance reports with conformant items, nonconformities, and improvement observations.
- Includes rules for common nonconformities and terminology corrections based on Codex and ISO 22000 standards.
